These are the events that have already occurred:

...
67. Humphrey Waylon was punished with three more years for another escape attempt.
68. Humphrey Waylon made a final escape attempt during his thirteenth year.
69. Humphrey Waylon was retaken after four hours of absence during his last escape attempt.
70. Humphrey Waylon was released in October 1815 after nineteen years of imprisonment.
71. Humphrey Waylon meditated on his misfortunes and the absurdity of his situation.


Below is a list of possible subsequent events:

['Humphrey Waylon stopped mid-repair of the broken fence to ponder.', 'Humphrey Waylon took a brief respite from his painting to consider.', 'Humphrey Waylon paused during his convict toil to think.', 'Humphrey Waylon slowed his rhythmic digging to muse.', 'Humphrey Waylon hesitated while sorting through the old documents to reflect.', 'Humphrey Waylon lingered at the edge of the forest to contemplate.']

 Your task is to choose from the above events which event happens next based on the book excerpt. In your response to me, only include the answer without anything else.
